label: early copy steps (recall 1-2) of short sequences (L<=4)
explanation: Update-gate unit that fires mostly in the copy phase on the first two outputs after the delimiter step (recall_idx 1 and 2, i.e. steps L+1 and L+2), and strongly prefers short sequences: L=3 and L=4 hold about 80% of activation mass. The largest activations (about 1.0 of max) are at recall_idx 1, where the first original token is fed back. That step is active about 99% of the time when L<=4, and much less for longer L. At recall_idx 2 it fires reliably when L=3 but only about half the time when L=4. It is almost silent on the delimiter step itself, at t=2..3, and at later copy positions. A second, weak and diffuse component appears at original step t=1 (21% of those steps are active but they carry only about 12% of mass); it is somewhat enriched when the input is s or x. The predicate gets dev precision 0.77 and mass recall 0.78, but recall is only 0.41 because it misses the many small t=1 and long-sequence activations.
